From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From costumbre (“custom”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /akostumˈbɾaɾ/ [a.kos.t̪ũmˈbɾaɾ]
  • Audio (Colombia):(file)
  • Rhymes: -aɾ
  • Syllabification: a‧cos‧tum‧brar

Verb

[edit]

acostumbrar (first-person singular present acostumbro, first-person singular preterite acostumbré, past participle acostumbrado)

  1. (transitive) accustom, inure, familiarize
    Synonym: avezar
  2. (intransitive) to use to (be in the habit of)
    Synonym: soler
  3. (reflexive) to get accustomed to
    Synonym: habituar
